cues: Barra sobre los trapecios, pies a ancho de hombros, rodillas siguiendo la punta de los pies.
Baja con el pecho alto hasta que la cadera pase la altura de la rodilla.
Sube empujando el suelo: la cadera y el pecho suben juntos, sin que la cadera se adelante.
Half squat: lower until the thigh is at about 45°, not parallel.
Lower under control and come up as fast as you can: speed is the goal, not the weight.
If the bar slows down on the way up, the load is too heavy.
One rep = all the way down, up halfway, all the way down again, then up to the top.
Light load (30/40/50%): this prepares you for the squat, it is not the effort.
Keep the tension at the bottom, no bouncing.
Barra sobre el medio del pie, pegada a las espinillas.
Antes de tirar: espalda neutra y dorsales apretados ("esconde las axilas").
Empuja el suelo con las piernas; la barra sube rozando las piernas y terminas con la cadera, sin echarte atras.
Peso muerto normal con una pausa de 2 s justo debajo de la rodilla.
En la pausa no pierdas la posicion: espalda neutra, barra pegada a las piernas.
Al 50%: se trata de controlar la posicion, no de mover peso.

banded-deadlift.yt: hip hinge warm up band dowel
cues: Rehearse the pattern with a dowel or empty bar, and the band to feel the tension.
Hip hinge: hips go back and the back stays straight.
Feel the hamstrings stretch before you stand up.
Empiezas de pie. Rodillas un poco flexionadas y fijas todo el recorrido.
Lleva la cadera atras deslizando la barra por los muslos hasta sentir tension en los isquios, normalmente bajo la rodilla.
Espalda neutra siempre; sube apretando gluteos.
Pesa en la mano contraria a la pierna de apoyo.
Cadera cuadrada al suelo: no la abras hacia el lado de la pierna que sube.
Pierna de atras y torso forman una sola linea.
Escapulas juntas y abajo, pies firmes en el suelo.
Baja la barra a la parte baja del pecho con los codos a unos 45° del cuerpo.
Empuja hacia arriba y un poco hacia atras, sin despegar la cadera del banco.
Misma tecnica del press de banca.
Baja en unos 2 s, pausa breve en el pecho y sube lo mas rapido posible.
Al 60-70% la barra debe volar; si se frena, baja la carga.
Banco a 30-45°.
Mancuernas a la altura del pecho alto, codos un poco por debajo de los hombros.
Sube juntandolas arriba sin chocarlas.
Borde del banco bajo las escapulas, barra sobre la cadera con almohadilla.
Pies a ancho de cadera; arriba, las espinillas quedan verticales.
Menton hacia el pecho. Sube apretando gluteos hasta que el torso quede paralelo al suelo, sin arquear la zona lumbar.
Cajon a la altura de la rodilla o un poco menos.
Sube empujando con el talon de la pierna de arriba; la de abajo casi no ayuda.
Baja controlado. e.l. = cada pierna.
Back foot on a bench. 4 reps with dumbbells: lower until the back knee almost touches the floor.
Drop the dumbbells and do 4 jumps in the same position, landing softly. That is the "4+4".
Torso leaning slightly forward; the front knee doesn't cave in.
Desde parado, contramovimiento rapido con los brazos.
Salta lo mas alto posible y aterriza suave, en cuclillas, con los dos pies.
Baja del cajon caminando. Descansa completo: es potencia, no condicion.

sl-box-jump.yt: single leg box jump two foot landing
cues: Take off on one leg, land on two.
Low box: the quality of the take-off matters, not the height.
Land stable before the next rep.
Arranca con la barra a mitad del muslo, torso inclinado, brazos estirados.
Extiende de golpe cadera, rodillas y tobillos, como un salto, y encoge los hombros al final.
Los brazos no tiran, solo guian. No hay recepcion de la barra.
Barra sobre los hombros, codos un poco adelante.
Flexion corta de rodillas (5-10 cm) con el torso vertical, y extiende de golpe.
Usa ese impulso para subir la barra; termina con los brazos bloqueados y la cabeza entre los brazos.
Mancuerna al hombro; la otra mano libre.
Flexion corta de rodillas, extension explosiva, bloqueo arriba.
No inclines el torso hacia el lado.
Dumbbell between the knees, hips back, arm straight.
Explosive hip extension; the dumbbell travels close to the body with the elbow high.
Catch it overhead with the arm locked, in one movement. RPE 6: clean technique before weight.
Barra en el pliegue de los codos, manos juntas. Usa almohadilla o toalla.
Torso muy vertical; baja entre las rodillas.
Codos pegados: si se abren, la barra cae y la espalda se redondea. 5-4-3-3 = series de 5, 4, 3 y 3.
Pesa al pecho; baja lo mas profundo que puedas con el pecho alto.
Usa los codos para empujar las rodillas hacia afuera.
Quedate 30 s respirando, talones en el suelo.
Cuerpo en tabla bajo la barra, talones en el suelo.
Lleva el pecho a la barra juntando las escapulas.
Mas horizontal = mas dificil.
Sube lo mas rapido posible, baja lento (3 s).
Cuerpo rigido: que la cadera no se caiga.
4x 5 con 90 s de descanso: calidad, no fatiga.
Agarre por encima, un poco mas ancho que los hombros.
Empieza colgando con los hombros activos, no sueltos.
Menton por encima de la barra, baja completo y controlado. Sin balanceo.
Agarre por debajo, a ancho de hombros.
Pecho hacia la barra, codos hacia las costillas.
RPE 9: si hace falta, lastre para que la ultima repeticion cueste.
Colgado con los brazos estirados.
Sin doblar los codos, baja los hombros lejos de las orejas: el cuerpo sube unos centimetros.
Aguanta 1 s y suelta controlado.
Hanging from the bar, shoulders pulled down, away from the ears.
Elbows straight, ribs down, legs together.
30 s without swinging.

calf-raise.yt: single leg calf raise on step
cues: On a step, heel hanging off.
Lower slowly to a full stretch and rise as high as you can; pause 1 s at the top.
One leg at a time.
Banda bajo los pies y por detras del cuello.
Bisagra de cadera con rodillas suaves y espalda recta, hasta que el torso quede casi paralelo.
Sube apretando gluteos. Banda ligera: es preparacion.
Cadera apoyada en el borde del cojin.
Baja con la espalda neutra y sube hasta alinear torso y piernas, no mas.
Aprieta gluteos arriba.
Torso sobre el banco, cadera en el borde, piernas colgando.
Sube las piernas juntas y estiradas hasta la horizontal apretando gluteos.
Baja controlado, sin impulso.
Face down, arms straight out in front.
Lift arms, chest and legs at the same time, looking at the floor.
Squeeze the glutes; don't lift your neck.
The same superman position, held.
Breathe normally through the 40-60 s.
Eyes on the floor, glutes squeezed.
Face down; lift your right arm and left leg, then the opposite pair.
Count the 40 reps alternating sides.
Eyes on the floor, hips don't twist.
Torso inclinado casi paralelo al suelo, mancuernas livianas, codos apenas doblados.
Abre los brazos hacia los lados juntando las escapulas.
Sin impulso: el peso bajo es a proposito.
Mano y rodilla sobre un banco, espalda plana.
Lleva la mancuerna hacia la cadera, no hacia el hombro.
Baja estirando completo.
Sentado con la espalda apoyada, codos pegados al cuerpo.
Sube girando la palma hacia arriba; baja lento.
No balancees el torso.
Dumbbell biceps curl, and from the top go straight into an Arnold press.
In the press, turn the palms out as you push overhead.
Come down the same way. One rep = curl + press.
Disco en la espalda o chaleco.
Cuerpo en tabla, manos a ancho de hombros, codos a unos 45°.
Pecho al suelo y arriba.
Baja en 5 s contados, cuerpo rigido.
Al tocar el pecho puedes apoyar rodillas para subir.
Lo que entrena es la bajada.
The Hindu push up goes from downward dog (hips high) to cobra, passing the chest close to the floor between the hands, and back.
The "half" version shortens the range: lower the chest and come back, without reaching full cobra.
The plan doesn't detail the "half"; if it isn't clear, check with the coach.
Elastic band across your back, held under your hands: you push against it.
The band loads more at the top, so push explosively all the way.
Body in a plank; few, fast reps.
Face up, lower back pressed to the floor.
Arms overhead and legs straight, both a few centimetres off the floor.
If your back lifts, raise your legs or bend your knees.
In the hollow position, alternate flutter kicks with straight legs.
The lower back never lifts off the floor.
40 kicks per set.
Between two boxes or parallel bars, arms straight and shoulders down.
Legs together and straight, parallel to the floor.
3x (3x max holds) = 3 sets of 3 max holds. If you can't get there, bend your knees.
Face up on a bench, holding the bench behind your head.
Raise your straight body to vertical, resting on your shoulders, and lower it as one piece as slowly as you can.
If your hips bend, bend your knees to make it easier.

side-plank-rot.yt: side plank rotation thread the needle
cues: Side plank on the forearm.
Thread the top arm under your body rotating the torso, then open back up.
Hips don't drop. 12 per side.
A gymnastics compression drill: sitting with legs wide and straight, lift the legs off the floor without using your hands.
Knees locked and toes pointed.
The exact variation isn't in the plan: watch the video and check with the coach.
Sit in a V holding an 8-10 kg bar or plate.
Rotate side to side, lowering each end toward the floor as if paddling a kayak.
Turn the torso, not just the arms. 20 per set.
Standing on a box, very light weight.
Roll the spine down one vertebra at a time from the chin; unroll on the way up.
In the plan: 6x 30 s holding at the bottom. It is loaded mobility, not strength.
Legs very wide.
Lower to one side, sitting on that leg; the other stays straight with the toes up.
Keep the working heel on the floor. 10 per side.
Ball between your legs, in a half squat.
Drive the hips through and throw forward and up as far as you can.
Whole body, not just the arms. Full rest between throws.
Standing, legs very wide and straight.
Hinge at the hips, bringing the torso toward the floor with a long back.
Relax and breathe at the bottom.
Band under your feet; one-arm press overhead.
5 s up, 5 s down: the tempo is the exercise.
Ribs down, don't arch your back.
A light plate in each hand, arms straight out to the sides.
Big, controlled circles.
10 in each direction (e.d.).
Plate in front of your chest; circle it around your head, close to the skull.
Ribs down and hips still.
Alternate the direction.
10 kg plate; press overhead to lockout.
Biceps next to the ear at the top, ribs down.
e.s. = each side.
Face down on an incline bench, thumbs up.
With straight arms draw the I (overhead), the Y, the T (out to the sides) and the W (elbows bent back).
No weight or very little: let the shoulder blades do the work. 10 of each letter.
Zancada larga, mano del lado de la pierna adelantada en el suelo, por dentro del pie.
Codo hacia el tobillo; luego rota el torso abriendo el brazo al techo.
Alterna lados.

down-up-dog.yt: downward dog to upward dog flow
cues: From downward dog (hips up, heels toward the floor)...
...lower the hips and open the chest into upward dog: arms straight, legs off the floor.
Go back. Smooth, with your breathing.
High plank; tap the opposite shoulder with one hand.
Hips don't move. Feet apart for stability.
16 alternating.
Deep squat with the heels on the floor.
Gently shift your weight side to side and forward and back.
In a deep squat, one hand on the floor.
Rotate the other toward the ceiling and follow it with your eyes.
Alternate. Heels on the floor.
Codos o manos sobre un banco, rodillas en el suelo lejos del banco.
Redondea la espalda completa (gato) y luego abrela bajando el pecho (vaca).
Lento, con la respiracion.
Band around the knees or ankles, in a half squat.
Step sideways without bringing the feet together and without the knees caving in.
Count the steps to each side.

shoulders-wrists.yt: plank shoulder circles wrist warm up
cues: High plank.
Move the shoulders in circles around the wrists: forward, to one side, back, to the other.
10 per side.
Foot a hand's width from the wall; bring the knee to touch it without lifting the heel.
If it touches easily, move the foot back.
Knee in line with the second toe.
With a band or light dumbbell: row until the elbow is at shoulder height.
Rotate the forearm up and press overhead.
Undo it in reverse order. Slow tempo, minimal weight.
Banda al frente a la altura del pecho, brazos estirados.
Abre hasta que la banda toque el pecho, juntando escapulas.
Hombros abajo, lejos de las orejas.
Disco al pecho, pies anclados.
Sube hasta sentado.
Baja controlado, sin dejarte caer.
Cable at chest height, your back to it.
Punch forward rotating hips and trunk, like a straight punch.
Control the return. 10 per side.
Face down on a high bench, bar hanging below.
Pull the bar up to the bench squeezing the shoulder blades; lower with straight arms.
The bench takes away the momentum: it is all back.
Tempo 3-2-0: 3 s down, 2 s pause at the bottom, up without pausing.
Heels on the floor, chest up.
This is preparation: find the position, not the fatigue.
